title: Is This Jar Really Full?
title_alternatives: This Jar Looks Full... Until the Small Ones Fall In
406 More Balls Fit in a "Full" Jar (Real Physics)
description:
Is this jar really full? Large rocks fill it to the brim... then medium, small and tiny balls keep finding gaps. 406 more balls fit inside, all by real rigid-body physics (no tricks, nothing placed by hand).

Simulated in Blender.

#Shorts #Physics #Satisfying #Simulation #Blender
